title: Batch Processing

body.text: For high-volume work that's not urgent, use the
Batch API — submit jobs as a batch, get results within 24 hours at half the price
. Great for summarizing thousands of documents, categorizing data, or translating lots of content.

example: "Send 10,000 customer reviews to the Batch API for sentiment analysis — done overnight, at half price"

title: Choose Batch or Real-time

body.text: a user is waiting for the answer → real-time / a large background job → batch
— a good system often uses both: live chat in real time, and daily reports processed as a batch at night.

example: "Customer chatbot → real-time / summarize the day's tickets for the manager in the morning → batch"

question: What's the advantage of the Batch API?

options.text: Half the price for work that can wait

question: What work is suited to the Batch API?

options.text: A chatbot where the customer is waiting

question: How does a well-designed system use Batch and Real-time?

options.text: Both together: real-time for live interaction, batch for background work

question: For a large, non-urgent volume of work, what's the cost-effective approach?

options.text: Send each request rushed, one at a time

question: When should you choose Real-time over Batch?

options.text: When the user needs an answer immediately
When there's a large non-urgent backlog
